prompt: Write a 3-sentence landing page hero section for an email marketing tool that focuses on saving time. Focus exclusively on benefits instead of features.
expected: Uses benefits not features, provides a clear CTA, short, punchy.
actual: Get out of your inbox and back to your life. Our platform handles the busywork so you can focus on what matters. Start your 14-day free trial today.

prompt: Improve this headline: 'Our accounting software has a new automatic reconciliation feature that is very fast and reliable'.
expected: Transforms features to benefits, adds specific numbers, removes vague adjectives.
actual: Reconcile your books in 3 minutes. Never hunt for a missing receipt again.
